te: Follow-up on the textbook e-bidding and a land matter in Chon Buri Province
se: The meeting was of the view that the Chair of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel should be invited to give information on the bidding. On the land matter in Chon Buri Province, if the complainant disagrees with the explanations of the Department of Lands and the Treasury Department, they should put their arguments in writing to the subcommittee.
it: Petition about the electronic price bidding (e-bidding) for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel
Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province

te: Follow-up on the textbook e-bidding and state property land in Mae Hong Son Province
se: The complainant about the textbook-printing bidding did not attend, so the meeting will write inviting them again to give information. On state property land in Mae Hong Son Province, the meeting agreed that Mae Hong Son Province should act as the lead agency, meet with the agencies concerned and report to the subcommittee.
it: Petition about the electronic price bidding (e-bidding) for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel
Petition asking for follow-up on the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land for public health services

te: Petition on the e-bidding for textbooks: the Comptroller General's Department gave information, and a study visit on water in Bangkok was scheduled
se: A representative of the Comptroller General's Department explained the procurement process, setting terms of reference and compliance with the Public Procurement Act B.E. 2560 (2017). The meeting was of the view that the complainant should be invited to give the facts, and set a study visit on Bangkok's water management at the Wang Thonglang District Office on 8 May 2026.
it: Petition about the electronic price bidding (e-bidding) for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel
Water-management study visit in Bangkok planned at the Wang Thonglang District Office

te: Problems with kratom-drink sales in Bangkok, and a complaint about a factory
se: The Ministry of Interior, the Royal Thai Police, the Office of the Narcotics Control Board, the Food and Drug Administration and the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration gave information on the sale of kratom drinks mixed with other substances, which is dangerous for children and young people. The agencies agreed to work together on the problem and will sign a memorandum of understanding (MOU). The meeting also considered a complaint from a private company about an order of the Department of Industrial Works.
it: The situation of kratom-drink sales in Bangkok
Petition from a private company about an order to stop operating a factory

te: Petition on the price bidding for printing textbooks by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel
se: The complainant raised points about the draft terms of reference (TOR), the make-up of the committee and the scoring criteria. The meeting was of the view that procurement should be transparent, fair and carefully open to checking at every step (the information is what the complainant alleges; the subcommittee is still fact-finding and nothing has been concluded).
it: Petition about the electronic price bidding (e-bidding) for printing textbooks for academic year 2026 by the trading organisation of the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel

te: Appeal to the Merit System Protection Commission: clarification received, matter closed
se: The OCSC Merit Protection Board explained that the appeal is under consideration and must be handled carefully given limited staff and a large number of cases. The complainant was satisfied with the explanation, so the meeting resolved to close the matter and report to the committee.
it: Petition from a civil servant asking for the appeal to the Merit System Protection Commission to be considered more quickly

te: Petition on a civil servant's appeal: the Department of Agriculture was invited to clarify
se: A representative of the Department of Agriculture explained the background. The complainant is appealing to the OCSC Merit Protection Board and feels the process is slow. The meeting was of the view that the complainant and the Merit Protection Board should be invited to give information.
it: Petition from a civil servant asking for the appeal to the Merit System Protection Commission to be considered more quickly

te: 3 complaints considered: land in Khon Kaen, state property land in Mae Hong Son, and an appeal by a civil servant
se: The meeting considered 3 complaints and resolved to write asking the Department of Lands, Khon Kaen City Municipality and the Treasury Department for more information, and to invite the Director-General of the Department of Agriculture to clarify the facts (the information is what the complainants allege; the subcommittee is still fact-finding and nothing has been concluded).
it: Petition about the boundary survey of a plot of land in Khon Kaen City Municipality
Petition asking for follow-up on the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land for public health services
Petition from a civil servant asking for the appeal to the Merit System Protection Commission to be considered more quickly

te: Petition on a request to use state property land in Mae Hong Son Province
se: The complainant asked for follow-up on the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land for public health. The meeting considered that the matter is under consideration by Mae Hong Son Province and will gather the facts to follow it up.
it: Petition asking for follow-up on the Mae Hong Son Provincial Administrative Organisation's request to use state property land for public health services

te: Hearing from the Comptroller General's Department on the public procurement system
se: The Comptroller General's Department gave an overview of the public procurement system and its efficiency, problems in enforcing the law and regulations, and ways to improve value for money, transparency and anti-corruption safeguards. The subcommittee will use the information in its study.
it: Situation, problems and development of the public procurement system

te: Review of work in 2025 and approach for 2026
se: The meeting considered the draft summary of work for 2025 and the approach for 2026, and approved inviting the Director-General of the Comptroller General's Department to give information on the public procurement system.
it: Draft summary of the subcommittee's work for 2025
Work approach for 2026
The Director-General of the Comptroller General's Department invited to give information on the public procurement system

te: Follow-up on a land matter in Chon Buri Province, and a water study visit to Ratchaburi Province scheduled
se: The Department of Lands and the Treasury Department gave more information. The meeting asked both agencies to summarise the background and facts for the subcommittee, and set a water-management study visit to Ratchaburi Province on 2 February 2026.
it: Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province
Schedule of the water-management study visit, Ratchaburi Province

te: Petition on the issuing of a land title deed in Chon Buri Province: hearing the petitioner
se: The complainant gave information to the meeting. The meeting was of the view that the Director-General of the Department of Lands and the Chon Buri Provincial Land Office, Phanat Nikhom Branch, should be invited to clarify further, and asked for documents on the history of title deeds in neighbouring areas and the original map sheets.
it: Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province

te: Petition on the issuing of a land title deed in Chon Buri Province: hearing information from the agencies
se: Representatives of the Department of Lands, the Chon Buri Provincial Land Office, Phanat Nikhom Branch, and the Treasury Department gave information on a complaint about issuing a title deed from a land reservation certificate for one plot. The meeting was of the view that surveyors should be invited to clarify further (the information is what the complainant alleges; the subcommittee is still fact-finding and nothing has been concluded).
it: Petition about the issuing of a title deed for a plot of land in Phanat Nikhom District, Chon Buri Province

te: Meeting 16/2569 · Subcommittee on the Development of the State Administration System and Public Sector Personnel
